issues: A pale grey desk with three grey placeholder dashboards: lying flat they were just a row of grey blocks, not three different pages
The pan went straight into the dive with no 'this one' beat, so the target felt random
The full-screen landing was a generic small-text dashboard (10–20px type), so the last frame was not a poster
changes: Graphite look: a dark matte slate desk with hairline grid, three overhead lamps each casting a light pool and a soft beam; white prints on a dark desk give the depth
The three prints are now the pricing, home and changelog pages of a fictional product 'Fieldwork', each with a printed desk tag (01 PRICING / 02 HOME / 03 CHANGELOG) that also shows the camera moving

A new selection beat: after the 50f pan stops, within 8f the target lifts 16px, its lamp brightens, the other two dim to 35% and its tag number turns gold; then all three channels dive together from 58f to 86f
The landed frame is a poster: a 150px two-line headline 'Plan the work. / Not the meeting.' (heavy sans plus serif italic) with a weekly planner product shot, margins of at least 120px
One small in-page action after landing: a gold 'Launch review' block slides into Wednesday's empty slot with one overshoot while the column below makes room; a 1.2% push-in keeps the hold alive
